name: feature.whatsapp.agents
description: The WhatsApp-facing customer-service agent (ADR 0394) — a PURPOSE-SPECIFIC persona scoped to defined functions, the structural answer to Meta's primary-functionality ban on general-purpose assistants. Minimal tool allowlist (workspace FAQ/knowledge lookup only); no web, exec, authoring, or open-ended tools. Composes the ONE chat (ADR 0058); no new chat surface. Pure-agent pack.
author: OpenWOP App

agents.label: WhatsApp Customer Service
agents.description: Answers customer questions over the workspace knowledge base — order/FAQ lookups within defined functions only. Deliberately NOT a general assistant (Meta's Business Solution Terms bar general-purpose AI as primary functionality on WhatsApp); requests outside its defined functions are redirected to a human.
